summary.text: Gary Walkowicz, a Working Class Party candidate, lost the November 3, 2026 election for U.S. House in Michigan's 12th District to Rashida Tlaib, a seat he had sought repeatedly.
Public sources reviewed do not document his education or career.

paragraphs.text: Walkowicz has run for U.S. House in Michigan's 12th District in 2014, 2016, 2018, 2022 and 2024.
In 2024 he received 2.6% of the vote as the Working Class Party candidate, and the party nominated him again at its convention on June 6, 2026.
He received 1.2% of the vote to Rashida Tlaib's 76.0%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
